name: Mackerel
summary: A detailing studio's bay at night with the strip lights on: a near-black ground, and the studio's light tubes as the one motif (thin lit bars as dividers, under the actions, lighting the stage a car has reached, and as focus). The hero is a headlight and bonnet at full height with the line lit in the dark of the paint; with a client's own matched pair it becomes the inspection light, swept across the panel. Funnel Display, light and tight, against Sora. One accent, the blue-green of a mackerel's back, used rarely. Photographs in one cool bay grade with warm highlights. For detailers, paint correction, coating and film studios.
